text: The IJCAI Award for Research Excellence is a biannual award presented at the IJCAI conference to recognize outstanding career achievements in artificial intelligence research. Starting in 2016, the IJCAI conference transitioned to an annual event, and consequently, the award has also been given annually since that year.
